resources.string: Your phone and computer, privately connected
Transfer files, chat and manage your phone over the same Wi-Fi — everything stays between your devices.
Manage your phone from a computer
Open one address in your computer browser to browse photos and videos, transfer files, and view the clipboard and notifications.
Chat and create channels between phones and computers. Content shared from other apps can be forwarded to a chat in one tap.
Photos from the weekend are ready, sending them over
Share from other apps → forward to a chat in one tap
Photos, music, notes and more handy tools — all work offline. Music supports synced lyrics.
Open PlainApp and start the service on the home screen
Connect your phone and computer to the same router
Open the address on your computer
Enter the web address shown on your phone screen in the browser
You can watch this intro again in Settings → How to use
Open your phone on your computer
Connect both devices to the same network. Turn on Remote access on the phone’s home screen, then enter the full address shown there in your computer browser.
Choose what can be accessed remotely
Open Access settings on the home screen to choose which features to share and manage sessions and security.
Use the switch on the phone’s home screen. The address appears below it.
Enter the full address, including the protocol and any port shown.
Check that both devices are on the same network and Remote access is on. If available, expand Try other addresses on the home screen.
A self-signed certificate can trigger this warning. Check that the HTTPS address matches the one shown on your phone.
In Access settings, check whether the feature is enabled and the required system permission is granted.
